title: Precompile architect plan
description: Structured block the precompile architect ends its plan with. Code graders compare it field by field against a case's expected plan. Every field is defined in prompts/output_contract.md, which both eval conditions receive.

verdict.description: proceed: the request can be done safely as asked. reject: doing it as asked would change how already-live blocks execute, so the plan declines and proposes a safe alternative.

approach.description: How the change reaches the code. Use none when verdict is reject.

activation_fork.description: Earliest fork whose blocks execute differently after this change, or null when no fork's execution changes. For a new version this is the version's introduction fork.

versions.description: Logic versions of the primary modules: those created, those whose logic or behavior changes, and those that must stay byte-for-byte unchanged.

files.description: Repo-relative paths. create and modify list every production and test file the plan touches. must_not_modify lists files whose contents must not change at all.

symmetric_modules.description: Every precompile module whose logic or dispatch changes. Empty when only shared or storage-layer code changes.

surfaces.description: Consensus-visible behavior that differs at activation_fork compared with the code before this change. All false for a pure refactor or a reject.

existing_goldens_unchanged.description: True when every existing golden pin (state roots, gas footprints, revert bytes) stays as it is.
